name: Text field and dark bubble
what: A text field with a handle at each end opens out of a single handle and fills with words that fade in one by one; then it grows, a dark bubble with a tail rises above it and is typed letter by letter, and both slide left to show their right ends before rising away.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f12 the field opens out of one handle (fast, decelerating) and keeps widening with its words (f14-f80, one word at a time); f108-f136 it scales up to 2.2 x (slow start, S-curve); f126-f159 a dark bubble rises from behind it and is typed; f137-f192 the group slides left in two pushes (f137-f146, f160-f172) and settles; f171-f193 it rises, accelerating

tracks.what: the field opens out of a single handle, then widens as words fade in
